preprocessing.name: canonical256_jpegpair_method_episodic_letterbox299
preprocessing.source_decode: Pillow decode followed by RGB conversion
preprocessing.shared_train_augmentation: one random horizontal flip p=0.5 shared by both views

episode.query_policy: rotate every seen method equally as pseudo-unseen
episode.support_policy: three of the five non-query methods, cyclically balanced across each epoch

objective.inner_update: one differentiable SGD step on support loss with first-order gradient approximation
objective.query_batchnorm: episode-local cloned running statistics; query does not update persistent BatchNorm buffers
objective.query_loss: adapted-model anchor-view cross-entropy plus feature consistency
objective.quality_consistency: one minus cosine similarity between global-pooled features of the two JPEG views
objective.second_view_role: feature consistency only, without an additional supervised cross-entropy term

optimization.reason: Match the Mixed-JPEG baseline's 16 unique source images per optimizer update while fitting two JPEG views on a T4-class GPU.
